svg.text: SIMT GPU - RTL Architecture & Signal Connectivity (top.sv, testbenches excluded)
4 lanes/warp | 4 warps | 32 vregs/lane | 32-bit | 5-stage pipeline IF->ID->EX->MEM->WB | round-robin scheduler | scoreboard RAW hazard stalls
top.sv ports: input clk, input rst -> routed to every sequential module (warp_manager, IFU, scoreboard, decode, vector_register_file, execute, mem_stage, instruction_memory, data_memory)
[ clk/rst ] badge = sequential module. writeback_stage and lane_alu/vector_alu are purely combinational. All arrays are per-lane [0:WARP_SIZE-1] x LANE_WIDTH(32).

compute_unit (u_compute_unit) ports: clk, rst, instruction_memory_address, instruction_memory_data, memory_read_enable, memory_write_enable, memory_active_lane_mask, memory_address[], memory_store_data[], memory_load_data[]
1 cycle later to line up with the
ALU_I : rt dest, rs src, imm
LOAD : rt dest, rs base, imm, mem read
STORE : rt src, rs base, imm, mem write
BEQ/BNE: rs,rt src, branch, no dest
branch_taken_comb: BEQ -> all active lanes src1==src2
out: result[] -> alu_result -> memory_alu_result[] (inactive lanes forced to 0)
stall_warp_id = warp of the winning source
stall_program_counter = PC of the blocked instruction
RAW check on rs/rt when rs_used / rt_used
blocked_* latches per warp (valid, src1, src2,
rs_used, rt_used) so blocked warp is re-checked
u_register_file [clk/rst] params WARP_SIZE NUM_WARPS NUM_VREGS LANE_WIDTH
if write_valid: for each lane with write_mask[lane]:
Thick arrow = bus of signals listed in the attached box (arrow head = destination).
Solid frame = RTL module; dashed frame = compute_unit boundary.
